Name: Flor Cuterish Portraits (Ridgeside Village)
Author: NoitaKuu
Description:
This is a slightly redesigned portraits of Flor from Ridgeside Village mod. I REALLY tried to do my mod with Portraiture or CP version, but i struggled for 2 days and gave up, so my portraits require manual installation :(

Instructions:
Open folder Stardew Valley/Mods/Ridgeside Village/[CP] Ridgeside Village/Assets/Portraits and replace old Flor.png and Flor_Dress.png with my new pngs from the folder
Thats all! Good luck
